title: Enterprise Private Deployment launch playbook: RBAC, Audit Logs, KMS
creator: Priya Raman
description: Goal: Coordinate cross-functional launch of Private/VPC/on-prem feature set (RBAC, Audit Logs, KMS) for enterprise customers. Deliverables: release notes, admin & runbook docs, Console/CLI enabling UX, sales & support enablement, pilot rollout plan, and required compliance approvals. Scope includes product decisions (RBAC role model and defaults, audit log retention/format, KMS options: customer-managed vs Redwood-managed), release gating (security review, infra readiness), and GTM artifacts (feature page, pricing guidance, sales battlecards). This ticket is the PM-owned launch playbook that aggregates owners, timelines, and acceptance criteria for GA readiness.
acceptance_criteria: RBAC role schema finalised and documented (Admin, Operator, Auditor, Reader) with API/Console mappings
Audit logging: schema + retention policy documented; sample logs available in S3-compatible format; ELT guidance in docs
KMS: supported modes documented (customer KMS via BYOK + Redwood-managed fallback); key rotation and backup guidance included
Release notes draft completed and approved by legal/compliance
Console toggle and CLI flag for enabling Private features built and validated in staging
Sales enablement deck and one-pager completed with pricing ranges and pilot checklist
Support runbook and incident escalation flow published; triage playbook for common misconfigurations
Pilot: 2 enterprise customers signed for early access and integration testing
Security review completed and all blockers resolved
GA launch checklist signed off by Eng, Security, Legal, Docs, and Sales Ops
